{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check for missing values in the variables of interest
print(f"Missing in flipper_length_mm: {df['flipper_length_mm'].isnull().sum()}")
print(f"Missing in body_mass_g: {df['body_mass_g'].isnull().sum()}")

# Check how many rows have both values present
complete_rows = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])
print(f"Number of rows with both flipper_length_mm and body_mass_g: {len(complete_rows)}")

# Compute the Pearson correlation using only complete cases
correlation = complete_rows['flipper_length_mm'].corr(complete_rows['body_mass_g'])
print(f"Pearson correlation (on complete cases): {correlation}")"}
